intro: Technology and cloud infrastructure sectors faced a concentrated wave of authorization bypass vulnerabilities between May 8 and May 17, 2026, with six articles covering critical flaws including CVE-2026-7813 (CVSS 9.9), CVE-2026-42880 (CVSS 9.6), CVE-2026-44574 (CVSS 8.1), CVE-2026-44575 (CVSS 8.1), and CVE-2026-33357 (CVSS 7.5). The two critical and three high-severity issues impacted consumer IoT, database management, and mobile network operators, while one medium-severity vulnerability was also documented.
